Nghỉ 1 ngày trong tuấn","benefits":["Competitive Compensation: 100% salary during probation, performance-based rewards, and attractive allowances.","Comprehensive Benefits: Full-salary social insurance, premium healthcare, and 15 days of annual leave.","Free English Learning: 100% free English courses for you or eligible family members.","Career Growth: Clear career paths, continuous learning, coaching, and new challenges."],"description":"A. Academic Leadership and Team Development
- Support the recruitment and onboarding of new teachers, ensuring readiness to deliver programs in line with academic standards.
- Strengthen teaching quality through structured lesson observations, targeted training, coaching, and actionable feedback for teachers.
- Manage and develop Academic Advisors (AAs), Tutors and Teaching Assistants (TAs) through observation, training, coaching and ongoing professional support.
- Uphold teacher and TA discipline and compliance with policies and procedures, coordinating timely follow-up and corrective action where required.

B. Academic Quality, Program Delivery and Student Experience
- Deliver high-quality teaching across all assigned programs, with particular emphasis on online delivery, and model effective instructional practice.
- Contribute academic recommendations to program development and improvement, and support planning and implementation as required.
- Monitor placement test results, learning progress, and student feedback to identify support needs and provide academic interventions that help students achieve their learning goals.
- Organize and coordinate student experience and engagement activities that support learning goals and sustained participation.
- Address academic-related requests, feedback, and complaints from students and Vietnamese parents through clear, timely communication in person or by phone.

C. Academic Operations and Cross-functional Collaboration
- Monitor academic KPIs, identify performance gaps, and recommend targeted initiatives to improve student outcomes, retention, and customer experience.
- Identify opportunities to streamline academic workflows and implement practical improvements to operational efficiency.
- Manage and allocate budgets for academic activities, ensuring effective use of resources in line with approved priorities.
- Work closely with other departments to align academic activities with operational requirements and business priorities.
- Undertake other academic and operational assignments as directed by the Head of Academics.","requirements_text":"Requirements:
5 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn
Cao học trở lên

Candidate Requirements
- Master’s degree or higher, preferably in English, Education or a related discipline. A recognized teaching qualification, such as TESOL or CELTA, is an advantage.
- At least 5 years of English teaching experience across programs ranging from young learners to test preparation, including at least 1 year in teacher mentoring, team supervision, or academic coordination.
- English proficiency at CEFR C1 or above (equivalent to IELTS 8.0 overall, with Speaking score 7.5+), with the ability to coach teachers, produce clear reports, and communicate academic matters with confidence
- Sound academic judgment, strong coaching and team leadership skills, and the ability to use data to improve performance. Effective parent communication, complaint resolution, resource planning, and cross-functional collaboration.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and academic management systems, particularly Excel for reporting and PowerPoint for training. Digital fluency and adaptability to new learning technologies are preferred."}
